purpose: Prospectively test whether completed-bar evolution supports a calibrated competing-risk long, short, or neutral state after the frozen one-shot three-state equations failed.

findings: The frozen target produced a genuine three-state population: roughly 24-27% long, 49-50% neutral, and 22-26% short.
Clock-prior, price-context, and price-plus-activity multinomial equations did not improve log loss portably.
The price models mainly predicted neutral; predicted long and short classes had low precision and very low recall.
The cost-aware directional outputs lost after 5 bps per side in both score periods.
Historical-volume activity did not supply a portable incremental signal.
Earlier opened research found one-to-three completed bars carried more payoff ranking information than static context, but not enough for positive expectancy.

hypothesis.name: dynamic_competing_first_touch_hazards
hypothesis.claim: Direction may become identifiable as a path evolves even when it is not identifiable at a one-shot fixed-clock decision.
hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Causally calibrated long or short expected net with a lower uncertainty bound above zero and nonzero stable coverage.
hypothesis.null: The posterior remains neutral/unknown or directional outputs fail post-cost stability gates.

frozen_state_equation.observation_clock: Update only after each newly completed bar; no intrabar values are used.
frozen_state_equation.up_hazard: h_up(k) = P(upper barrier is first touched during next bar | neither barrier touched through completed checkpoint k, causal x_k)
frozen_state_equation.down_hazard: h_down(k) = P(lower barrier is first touched during next bar | neither barrier touched through completed checkpoint k, causal x_k)
frozen_state_equation.survival: S(k) = product from j=1 through k of max(0, 1 - h_up(j) - h_down(j))
frozen_state_equation.long_probability: Sum over future k of S(k-1) * h_up(k)
frozen_state_equation.short_probability: Sum over future k of S(k-1) * h_down(k)
frozen_state_equation.neutral_probability: Residual survival probability through the frozen horizon plus explicitly unresolvable same-bar paths.
frozen_state_equation.long_expected_net: Probability-weighted realised long path payoff after the frozen cost model.
frozen_state_equation.short_expected_net: Probability-weighted realised short path payoff after the frozen cost model.
frozen_state_equation.state: Long only when the lower uncertainty bound of long expected net is above zero and exceeds short; short symmetrically; neutral/unknown otherwise.

target_and_cost_boundary.same_bar_dual_touch: Unresolvable at five-minute resolution and never counted as a directional success.
target_and_cost_boundary.short_borrow_and_market_impact: Not modelled; any short economic result remains research-only and incomplete.

required_causal_log: immutable source, model, feature, target, and contract versions
full eligible population before state selection
causal price geometry, returns, compression, opening-range position, session position, and scale
historical-volume activity proxy with its precise provenance label
running favourable and adverse excursion available through the completed checkpoint only
upper hazard, lower hazard, survival, long probability, short probability, and neutral probability
long and short expected net with uncertainty and support
emitted long, short, or neutral/unknown state
sealed first-touch class, same-bar ambiguity, MFE, MAE, time-to-touch, and gross/net outcomes opened only after expiry
activation_requirements: Set an immutable activation timestamp before the first genuinely new observation.
Hash model source, features, barrier, costs, training window, calibration, uncertainty, and state equation before activation.
Do not select checkpoint, barrier width, threshold, feature subset, or calibration neighbourhood from the opened static or sequential tails.
Keep eligible, checkpoint, hypothetical-state, and sealed-outcome ledgers separate.
Do not activate through or implement in the trading application without separate explicit authorization.
evaluation: three-state log loss, Brier score, calibration, balanced accuracy, macro F1, and per-class precision/recall
paired net payoff per full eligible opportunity and per directional output
independent timestamp, feature, target, leakage, payoff, and exact-rerun audit

provenance.loops: excluded from the primary model; they may enter only as a separately frozen incremental comparator
provenance.market_or_sector_context: requires a separately frozen timestamp-audited source
